notes: \(^{{*}}These include mainly(i) Children apprehended for begging; (ii) Children found intoxicated by liquor or dangerous drugs; (iii) Children indulging in betting or borrowing; (iv) Children apprehended from brothels; (v) Children indulging in smoking etc.; (vi) Children having no homes, settled place or visible means of subsistence or having no parents or guardians who could exercise regular and proper guardianship**These include offences under the Indian Penal Code, Indian Arms Act, Explosives Act, Explosive Substances Act, Habitual Offenders Act, Indian Railways Act-(Petty cases), etc.
